name: king-of-diamonds
description: King of Diamonds — real-time multiplayer beauty-contest where strategy crowns the worthy.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,red,cyan "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
